title: Encoding and decoding Boolean functions
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number and let $g$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^r$ with values in $\{\pm1\}$. Converting $g$ to its binary-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^r$ and then converting back recovers $g$ at every input.
